'''Sluis Van''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sluissi]] race and the location of the famous [[Sluis Van Shipyards]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The Sluis sector is a large expanse of sparsely populated space, renowned for its mineral resources and processing facilities. Its primary system, Sluis Van, maintains a formidable shipyard for construction and maintenance.|HoloNet News|<ref name="HNN49" />}}
[[File:Sluissi-TUR.png|thumb|left|180px|Sluissi, the native species of Sluis Van]]
Sluis Van was a world located along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the capital of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]],<ref name="HNN56" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of an extensive [[Sluis Van Central space station|deep-space docking facility]] and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], the largest and most impressive in the area. The docking station was defended by perimeter [[battle station]]s, while the shipyards were managed by an outer system defense network as well as the [[Sluis Control]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The ruler of Sluis Van was called a [[khedive]],<ref name="HNN56" /><ref name="Insider69" /> while the [[Sluis Van Congregate]] held a considerable influence.<ref name="R&R:TJtC">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|Not only were the shipyards that encircled the planet destroyed, but we are told that the Sith invaders slaughtered everyone who did not immediately swear allegiance to the apparent leader of the Sith, an unnamed Emperor of whom absolutely nothing is known.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
<div style="float: right">[[File:Sluis_ggw.jpg|thumb|220px|The [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|fall of Sluis Van]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].]]</div>
Sluis Van was discovered by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] explorers,<ref name="UAA" /> during the [[Subterra Period]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Sluissi were long supporters of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TCSWE-Sluissi" /> with Sluis Van being home to a vital network of Republic shipyards that were [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|destroyed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Timeline 6" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|As we speak, a fleet of one hundred twenty-six ships, seventy-five of them capital ships, is investing Sluis Van to block any reinforcements from that sector.|Admiral Pors Tonith to Asajj Ventress|<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref>}}
Millennia later, during the final years of the Republic, they became disgusted with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] whom they blamed as being massively corrupt and causing galaxy-wide injustice.

The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by [[Bor Gracus]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> and then [[Corlissi Ludar]], until [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when Sluis Van seceded during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN49" /> [[Candobar Inglet]] was the the Sluissi Khedive prior and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN56" /><ref name="Insider69" />

During the Clone Wars, Sluis Van was located in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space and the Sluis Van shipyards produced starships for the Confederate forces.<ref name="Insider68">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref> However, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the system was [[Battle of Sluis Van (Clone Wars)|blockaded]] by a massive Separatist fleet to block any Republic reinforcements in the area, particularly during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].<ref name="JT" /><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At the end of the Clone Wars, the Sluis Van system had become a Separatist stronghold. As well as many other Confederate worlds, it was besieged by Republic forces during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="TEA" /> Sluis Van held off the Republic. However, the civilians didn't fare well, as mass-starvation broke out on the planet as a result of the Outer Rim Sieges.

===Galactic Civil War===
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Sluis Van was a major [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipyard and was heavily guarded.<ref name="EotECR" /><ref name="AoRCR" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] under control of [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]. Sluis Van was [[Battle of Sluis Van (Delvardus campaign)|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Despite the [[Sluis Van Congregate]] not wanting to cut all connections to the Empire, being as it was one of their largest shipyard clients, the planet joined the New Republic several months after the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="R&R:TJtC" /><ref name="TCSWE-Sluissi" />

[[File:Sluisvan_swkm.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] orbiting Sluis Van]]

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] were one of the main shipyards of the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was the site of a [[Battle of Sluis Van|battle]] with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="HttE" /> He attacked 112 stripped-down warships docked over the planet, attempting to capture some of them. Although he failed, Thrawn's forces managed to leave over 40 of the vessels with inoperable control systems.<ref name="TCSWE" />

===Later history===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the world and its shipyards were crucial to keeping the New Republic supplied with new warships. Following the [[Battle of Fondor|loss]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], additional units of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]], including several carriers, were deployed to the region for added protection, when Sluis Van took over Fondor's operations.

Sluis Van went on to be a key world in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], it was feared that its shipyards would be a target for the forces of the newly formed [[Confederation]].<ref name="Exile" /> By [[137 ABY]], the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|New Galactic Empire]] under the control of the [[One Sith]] had seized control of Sluis Van. Despite this, the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] stayed influent on the planet and in the region.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sluis Van was named by author [[Timothy Zahn]] after his friend Don Vandersluis.<ref name="HTTE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis sector and, consequently, Sluis Van, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

On page 227 in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the name of the planet is misspelled as "Sluis Var".
